# Scoped acceptance cases seed
Apply [GOV-VAL-001](../contracts/VALIDATION_AND_CLOSURE.md) in the existing owner record. Use relevant fields proportionately; do not duplicate task status or create another ledger.

- Deliverable, selected scope and required authority:
- Decision, concrete risk and acceptance criteria fixed before tests:
- Check classification: MANDATORY / CONDITIONAL (trigger) / OPTIONAL / REDUNDANT:
- Exact source revision and fixture assumptions:
- Reused evidence pointer and validity of scope/content/environment/dependencies:
- Actor/audience/object/state and entry/exit conditions:
- Positive path, denial/empty/error and cross-context cases:
- Expected result, confirmed basis and implementation dependency:
- Test layer: static / prototype / application / human acceptance:
- Result: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN, actual evidence and limits:
- Technical checks still required despite design-scope acceptance:
- Additional tests, if proposed: risk/hypothesis, possible outcomes, decision effect and proportional cost:
- Scoped closure assessment, remaining blockers/non-blocking caveats and next authorized activity:
- Any waiver: criterion, approver, reason, expiry and residual risk:
- Owner history and existing task transition authority:
